tagline.en: Vodafone-based UK MVNO — £5 top-up per 90 days, Wi-Fi Calling
tagline.zh: Vodafone网络英国虚商——充5镑延90天，支持Wi-Fi Calling

description.en: Lebara is an international MVNO running on Vodafone UK's network. Order eSIM directly on the official site; a minimum £5 top-up extends the number's validity by 90 days — cheap per event but a 2x/year cadence. Wi-Fi Calling supported; a China-roaming data bundle was briefly offered and then withdrawn.
description.zh: Lebara是走Vodafone英国网络的国际虚商。官网可直接下单eSIM；最低充值5英镑延长号码有效期90天——单次便宜但一年要充两次。支持Wi-Fi Calling；曾短暂推出中国漫游流量包后又取消。

details.en: Lebara's keep-alive economics: £5 per 90 days — the lowest per-event top-up among reviewed UK options, but at twice-a-year cadence it lands near Lycamobile's £10/180 days and above giffgaff's near-zero SMS route. It rides Vodafone's infrastructure (good coverage quality), supports Wi-Fi Calling, and sells eSIM directly at checkout. The China-relevant caveat is directional: Lebara briefly launched a China-roaming data bundle and then cancelled it, and its marketing centres on international calls to South Asia — the source review files it in the low-cost/flexible MVNO tier, not the China-roaming tier. For a UK number kept alive from anywhere with minimal fuss and Vodafone-grade coverage, it works; for mainland-China data use, look at CTExcel/CMLink instead.
details.zh: Lebara的保号经济账：每90天充5英镑——单次充值门槛是本轮英国选项中最低的，但一年两次的节奏算下来与Lycamobile的10英镑/180天相近，高于giffgaff近乎为零的短信路线。它走Vodafone网络设施（覆盖质量好）、支持Wi-Fi Calling、官网结账可直接选eSIM。与中国相关的注意点是方向性：Lebara曾短暂上线中国漫游流量包后又取消，营销重心在南亚国际通话——源盘点将其归入低价灵活虚商梯队，而非回国漫游梯队。要一个在哪都能低操心保号、Vodafone级别覆盖的英国号码，它可用；要中国大陆流量，请看CTExcel/CMLink。

bestFor.en: Low-effort keep-alive on Vodafone-grade coverage with small £5 top-ups.
bestFor.zh: 想以5英镑小额充值在Vodafone级覆盖上低操心保号的用户。
